# Agent Marketplace
Pick skills and MCP servers once, then use them in any AI client through a single parent MCP server.
# working proof of concept
jose@sys:~$

Every AI client keeps its own list of skills and MCP servers. Setting them up one client at a time is tedious, the lists drift out of sync, and a setup built for one provider doesn't carry over to another. An organization also has no single place to approve, grant, or revoke what its agents can use.
